_comment: B2 (epic #167 / ADR-26) — HARNESS-LOCAL sample workload catalog.
Shape mirrors var.workload_registries (terraform/modules/regional-stack/
variables.tf): a map keyed by deploy-repo name, each carrying the ECR
coordinates + opt-in engine_irsa / ingress_cert the ApplicationSet List
generator turns into per-workload elements (argocd.tf ::
local.workload_list_elements). scripts/e2e/b2/assert-workload-onboarding.sh
reads THIS file and runs the SAME transformation to build the harness
ApplicationSet's generator elements — so the kind lane exercises the exact
onboarding path A5 (migrate the workload ApplicationSet) must preserve.
The values here are PLACEHOLDERS — no real account IDs (this file is
committed; the production registries.auto.tfvars.json stays gitignored). On
kind the ECR account/region only ever surface as the injected
aegis.binhsu.org/ecr-repository ANNOTATION (never a live pull target — the
image itself comes from the in-cluster registry:2 mirror), so a placeholder
account ID exercises the injection without touching AWS.
aegis-sample-deploy is ENGINE-LIKE on purpose: declaring engine_irsa gates
the model-store ConfigMap injection (argocd.tf templatePatch), so this one
workload exercises BOTH the always-on commonAnnotations (region + ecr-
repository) AND a conditional templatePatch injection that actually FIRES —
while the cert / gateway-oidc guards stay OFF (no ingress_cert, no Cognito
values), proving the guard-off path too.
